name.ja: プラノサウルス パラサウロロフス

description.ja: 自分の手で恐竜を“知りつくす”ブランド『プラノサウルス』第9弾に、とさかが特徴的な恐竜「パラサウロロフス」が登場！
description.en: Parasaurolophus, a dinosaur with a distinctive crest, is now available in the 9th installment of Planosaurus, a brand that helps you get to know dinosaurs with your own hands!

description.ja: • 「骨格ビルド」で恐竜の内部構造から知ることができる。
description.en: • "Skeleton Build" allows you to learn about the internal structure of dinosaurs.

description.ja: • 「恐竜ビルド」で骨格の上から外皮パーツを取り付けるプラモデルならではの仕様で恐竜の姿を復元。
description.en: • "Dinosaur Build" allows you to restore the dinosaur's appearance using specifications unique to plastic models, where the skin parts are attached to the top of the skeleton.

description.ja: • ニッパー等の道具や接着剤が必要ないから簡単に組み立てられる。
description.en: • Easy to assemble as there is no need for tools such as nippers or adhesives.

description.ja: • パーツの選択でとさかの異なるオス、メスそれぞれを再現可能。
description.en: • Male and female figures with different crests can be reproduced by selecting parts.

description.ja: • 走る際に体の釣り合いを取るだけでなく、泳ぐ際にはスクリューの役割も果たした上下に平たい長い尾も再現。
description.en: • The long tail, which is flat at the top and bottom, not only balances the body when running, but also serves as a screw when swimming.

description.ja: • 鳥盤類に特有の大きく発達した前恥骨突起もリアルに表現。
description.en: • The large, developed prepubic process unique to ornithischians is also realistically expressed.

description.ja: • 近縁種の化石の研究から、背面にはイグアナと同じようなたてがみ状の鱗があったと考えられている。これらの造形も学説に基づいて表現。
description.en: • Based on studies of fossils of closely related species, it is believed that the animal had mane-like scales on its back similar to those of iguanas. These shapes are also expressed based on academic theories.

description.ja: • 前肢、後肢、首や尾など各所が可動し、好みのポージングでディスプレイが可能。
description.en: • Various parts such as the front legs, hind legs, neck and tail are movable, allowing you to display your favorite poses.
